description: This file defines the 'ReviewerGroup' class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It models a reviewer group entity with properties like id, name, piority, and associated ratings, including methods for setting and retrieving these properties.

classes.name: ReviewerGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of reviewers in the HRM system, with properties for id, name, piority, and associated reviewers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the reviewer group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: getPiority
methods.description: Returns the piority of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setPiority
methods.description: Sets the piority of the reviewer group.
